scope: Foreground recipient pairing completion without route replacement or launch cover
rootCauses: Both existing private realtime topics cleared the entire Burrow snapshot on pair changes, including first pairing from a solo account.
The environment gate treated a temporary missing snapshot owner as a new app entry.
The connected UI was owned only by the explicit pairing route, so recipients on other pages had no success presentation.
changes: Retain only an already-solo personal scene during pair verification. Existing-pair invalidation still clears private partner data immediately.
Use authenticated account identity during snapshot verification gaps; no new launch cover for a same-account pair change.
Present the existing connected design in a global window overlay only after authenticated bootstrap and portrait preparation, with ready initials on portrait failure.
Dismiss only the overlay, leaving the underlying route mounted. Suppress duplicate, stale-session, restored-session and inline-invite presentations.
